name: workspace
description: GitHub repo indexing and file workspace. Index repos into MongoDB, read/search files, store patches. No filesystem needed.

action.description: index: clone and index a GitHub repo. repos: list indexed repos. list: list files in a repo. read: get file content. search: search file contents. patch: store a code patch. patches: list stored patches. apply: apply a stored patch. drop: remove a repo from the index.
